data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (claims reserves) at 1 January 2016 is taken from the balance sheet prior-year column. The report does not provide a clearly labelled gross 'movement in prior years provision for claims outstanding' figure that can be unambiguously extracted from the scanned pages; therefore prior-year development (gross) is not reported here.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction from scanned images: the Balance Sheet line 'Claims outstanding' (Gross claims outstanding) for the prior year (2015) was located on the Technical Provisions / Liabilities page and reads as GBP 31,503,000 (reported here as 31.503). A clear, labelled GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could not be confidently located in the provided images - tables and notes that are present include claims/triangle and various movements but the scanned quality, rotation and partial cropping prevented reliable identification of a single gross prior-year movement figure. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Gross premiums written was inferred from a segmental/summary table as GBP 97,895,000 (97.895) but the exact segmental breakdown could not be confidently transcribed from the images, so gross_premium_mix is left empty and gross_premium_confidence is low. No claims development triangle suitable for programmatic extraction was found with sufficient clarity in the provided images. Numeric amounts taken from scanned pages should be cross-checked against the original PDF for audit purposes.
